items.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: And, well, Ray Bauduc's brother taught me how to play banjo.

ctx.x: You did at that, huh? Yeah, I was in the band in a month's time. Did you have lessons when you took up the banjo? How old were you, though?
Oh, gee, I don't know, I was a little kid, but, oh, I must have been 13 years old, I guess. 12 years old, at least. And, well, Ray Bauduc's brother taught me how to play banjo. Oh, Ray's brother?

Yeah. Better sit down here, Ray. Well, that's all right, Ray. Just sit down. Sit down. No, no, no, there's plenty of chairs here. I'll just get to do something over here. All right. If you all, maybe we could talk together, and if you wanted one of you to be upstairs, get a little bit of a bed in.
